notes: MoneyForge 1.0.5: one-click posting to YouTube; Facebook, Instagram, Threads and TikTok switch on automatically as each platform approves (no reinstall). Fixes: videos and reels no longer fail at random, background music no longer drops silently, lyric-card music videos now run on 4-6 GB cards, clear messages when a mode needs a bigger card or a missing voice, starter music and sound effects, Restart button in Settings, and a full uninstall option.
